method: Independent, evidence-only Cursor CLI synthesis. The model received only this entity's saved evidence package.

sentiment.summary: Insufficient relevant coverage in the provided 30-day evidence set to assess Solana ecosystem/news sentiment reliably. Only one relevant report describes a network stress event where a data center routing glitch took ~29% of staked tokens offline and brought Solana near a freeze threshold, while the Solana Foundation said blocks and transactions never stopped.
sentiment.coverage_note: Only 1 Solana-relevant record from an ok-status named source was present; other records were not Solana-specific. Additional collection sources show failures/no results (e.g., reddit auth-failed; grounding/youtube no-results), limiting breadth and preventing a non-insufficient assessment under the minimum-evidence rule.
